Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference
Constants

Do Not Disturb States

The telDNDNDMsg message can return any of the following constants to indicate the status of the do not disturb feature. 
enum {
   telDNDCleared           = 0,
   telDNDEst               = 1,
   telDNDFailed            = 2
};
Constant descriptions
telDNDCleared
Do not disturb has been cleared.
telDNDEst
Do not disturb has been established.
telDNDFailed
Attempt to set up do not disturb has failed.
